description: Main source file for CWMP daemon, handling configuration, signal processing, service initialization, and main event loop.

methods.name: is_valid_ipv4
methods.description: Checks if the provided IP string is a valid IPv4 address.

methods.name: is_valid_ipv6
methods.description: Checks if the provided IP string is a valid IPv6 address.

methods.name: ip_type
methods.description: Determines if the IP address is IPv4 or IPv6.

methods.name: is_ipaddr
methods.description: Checks if the string is a valid IP address (IPv4 or IPv6).

methods.name: cwmp_app_handleSignal
methods.description: Handles termination signals to gracefully stop the application.

methods.name: app_usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the cwmpd application.

methods.name: cwmp_add_sahtrace_zones
methods.description: Adds trace zones based on configuration.

methods.name: cwmp_app_parse_config
methods.description: Parses the configuration file and sets application parameters.

methods.name: cwmp_app_configureDefaults
methods.description: Sets default configuration values for the application.

methods.name: cwmp_app_configureOptions
methods.description: Parses command-line options to override default settings.

methods.name: cwmp_app_http_server_restart
methods.description: Restarts the HTTP server used by the application.

methods.name: cwmp_app_clean
methods.description: Performs cleanup of resources before shutdown.

methods.name: cwmp_app_engineEventHandler
methods.description: Handles engine events such as restart, stop, start, URL change.

methods.name: cwmp_app_settings
methods.description: Initializes application settings, parses configuration, and daemonizes if needed.

methods.name: cwmp_app_init_dmengine
methods.description: Initializes the data model engine and connects to the data model.

methods.name: cwmp_app_init_services
methods.description: Starts services like HTTP server, DNS, and HTTP client.

methods.name: cwmp_app_enable_notifications
methods.description: Enables notifications and starts main event loop.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point for the cwmpd application, orchestrating initialization and cleanup.
